description: This PHP class 'PsrHttpFactoryHelper' provides utility methods for converting between PSR-7 HTTP message interfaces and Symfony HttpFoundation request and response objects. It encapsulates factory creation and conversion methods to facilitate integration between PSR-7 and Symfony HTTP components within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to create and convert between PSR-7 and Symfony HTTP message objects, managing internal factories.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactory
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a PsrHttpFactory instance, creating it with a new Psr17Factory if necessary.

methods.name: getHttpFoundationFactory
methods.description: Returns the existing HttpFoundationFactory instance or creates a new one if not already set.

methods.name: createPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 server request object from a Symfony request.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 response object from a Symfony response.

methods.name: createRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a Symfony request object from a PSR-7 server request.

methods.name: createResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a Symfony response object from a PSR-7 response.
